literal_mathematics.definitions: a_i=sum_{m=0}^i choose(k+i-m,k)/m!; b_r=sum_{i=0}^k [i<=r<=k] a_i*choose(k-i,r-i)/choose(2k+1,r); c_r=exp(-1)*b_r+b_(2k+1-r), with Nat saturated subtraction. B=(k+1)^2*2^(3k), D_r=k!*choose(2k+1,r), S_i=sum_m choose(k+i-m,k)*(k!/m!), A_r=sum_i [i<=r<=k] S_i*choose(k-i,r-i). The S formula uses Nat division, not rational division.
literal_mathematics.range_proof: For i<=k and contributing m, k+i-m<=2k and m!>=1, so a_i<=(k+1)*2^(2k). Every contributing elevation numerator is <=2^k and its binomial denominator >=1; there are k+1 possible terms. Thus 0<=b_r<=B for every Nat r. exp(-1)<=1 gives 0<=c_r<=2B for every Nat r, including the total-function out-of-range behavior. No k-independent constant bound is substituted.
literal_mathematics.factorial_clearing: For m in range(i+1) with i<=k, m<=k gives m! dividing k!, and factorial positivity justifies Nat.cast_div. S_i/k! equals a_i only on this index domain. The leftNumerator equality sums these valid i terms. D_r>0 requires r<=2k+1; real total division makes leftNumerator_value still valid outside that domain, where b_r=A_r=D_r=0.
literal_mathematics.restriction: 0<=u<v<=1 implies u<1 and z=(v-u)/(1-u) in [0,1]. The existing right and left de Casteljau convexity providers preserve [0,2B] for valid coefficient index r<=2k+1. Zero-width, reversed and out-of-unit intervals are not covered by this strict-domain theorem.
literal_mathematics.rational_endpoint: For p,q:Nat, q>0 and r<=2k+1, E=p/q has N=p*A_r*D_ref+q*A_ref*D_r and T=q*D_r*D_ref>0. These representation/envelope statements do not require p<=q. The value range for an arbitrary supplied scalar separately requires e in [0,1] via fromConstant_range.
literal_mathematics.stored_consumer: fromConstant_range rewrites actual StoredHermiteCoefficients.fromConstant_value, with r:Fin(2k+2). Its scalar interval premise is a reusable INTERNAL provider obligation, not a new scientific Source Anchor assumption or a supplied exp oracle. e=0 is allowed and may create zero entries; existing compile_pos for exact exp(-1) is not upgraded to arbitrary fromConstant.
literal_mathematics.output_envelopes: D<=2^(k^2+3k+1), A<=2^(2k^2+9k+3), T<=q*2^(2k^2+6k+2), N<=(p+q)*2^(3k^2+12k+4). The integer power inequalities are formal roots. Converting them into binary lengths, allowing a +1 at equality for powers of two, and reduced Fraction divisibility are elementary consequences/finite checks here, not additional Lean bitLength roots. Complexity is polynomial in NUMERIC k plus scalar operand bits, not polynomial in log(k).
